page.overview:
Who is Mackenzie Family?

The Mackenzie family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Bob Mackenzie from the first story of Fazbear Frights 5: Bunny Call.

Bob Mackenzie is the husband of Wanda Mackenzie and the father of Cindy, Tyler, and Aaron. He is the main protagonist of the Bunny Call story.

Wanda Mackenzie is the wife of Bob Mackenzie and the mother of three children.

Cindy Mackenzie is the daughter of Bob and Wanda Mackenzie, and the sister of Tyler and Aaron. She is the youngest of her siblings.
